newsitem.title: INDIA: India among top performing markets in April - Morgan.
newsitem.headline: India among top performing markets in April - Morgan.

text.p: The Indian stock market has been rated among the best performing Asian emerging markets in April, Morgan Stanley Capital International said in a study on Friday.

"In India, positive political developments including the swearing in of a new prime minister who expressed confidence in the passage of a market-friendly budget more than erased the 8.1 percent loss in March," Morgan Stanley said.

Indian stock markets staged a 12.7 percent rally in April, the study said. Sri Lankan stocks and China Free stocks surged 15.4 percent and 13.2 percent, respectively, thus topping the list of the best performing Asian emerging markets, Morgan added.
